t2.title: The future of zoos
t2.prompt:
You are participating in an online discussion for students and teachers.

The question is:

"Should zoos continue to exist, or should all wild animals live only in their natural habitats?"

Post your response, giving reasons and examples.
t2.sample: Whether zoos should continue to exist is a hotly debated topic, and it is one I find genuinely difficult to answer. On the one hand, I understand the appeal of allowing all animals to roam freely in their natural habitats. Nevertheless, I believe that well-run modern zoos play a vital role that we should not dismiss. Firstly, they support endangered species through breeding and conservation programmes, protecting animals that might otherwise disappear. Secondly, they raise awareness: seeing a real animal can inspire people to care about the environment far more than a textbook ever could. On the other hand, I accept that keeping animals in captivity raises serious welfare concerns, and cramped, old-fashioned zoos are indefensible. All things considered, I do not think the answer is to close every zoo. Instead, we should strike a balance — investing in spacious, ethical sanctuaries that put animal welfare first while continuing the vital work of conservation.
t2.sampleA1: Some people say zoos are bad. Some people say zoos are good. I like zoos. In a zoo we can see many animals. Children learn about animals. But animals need space. So zoos must be big and clean. I think zoos can stay, but they must be good for animals.
t2.sampleA2: Some people think all animals must live in nature. Other people think zoos are good. I think zoos can be good. In a zoo, we can see animals and learn about them. Zoos also help animals that are endangered species. But animals need a lot of space and good food. In conclusion, I think zoos can stay, but they must be big, clean and safe for the animals.
t2.sampleB1: This is a hotly debated topic. Some people think all wild animals should live only in nature, but I do not fully agree. First of all, good zoos play a vital role because they protect endangered species and help them have babies. Also, when children see real animals, they learn to love nature. On the other hand, some zoos are too small and the animals are not happy. So the animals can become sad or sick. In conclusion, I think zoos should not close, but they must be big and clean, and they must take good care of the animals.
t2.sampleB2: This is such an interesting question, and honestly I can see both sides. On the one hand, there's something a bit sad about keeping wild animals in captivity when they were born to roam freely in natural habitats. That said, I don't think closing every zoo is the answer. Modern zoos do a huge amount of good — they protect them from extinction through breeding programmes and they raise awareness in a way no documentary really can. When a child meets a real elephant, they often want to get involved and help protect it. On top of that, releasing every animal in the wild simply isn't realistic; many wouldn't survive. So for me, zoos are a bit of a double-edged sword. The real solution is to strike a balance: shut down the cruel, old-fashioned ones and support modern, ethical sanctuaries that genuinely put the animals first. What does everyone else think?

Hayvonot bog'lari mavjud bo'lib qolishi kerakmi, degan savol — <mark>qizg'in muhokama qilinadigan mavzu</mark>, va menga rostdan ham javob berish qiyin bo'lgan savol. <mark>Bir tomondan</mark>, barcha hayvonlarga o'zlarining <mark>tabiiy yashash muhitida</mark> erkin sayr qilishga ruxsat berish g'oyasi menga tushunarli.

Shunga qaramay, menimcha, yaxshi boshqariladigan zamonaviy hayvonot bog'lari biz e'tibordan chetda qoldirmasligimiz kerak bo'lgan <mark>muhim rol o'ynaydi</mark>. Birinchidan, ular ko'paytirish va muhofaza dasturlari orqali <mark>yo'qolib ketayotgan turlarni</mark> qo'llab-quvvatlaydi. Ikkinchidan, ular xabardorlikni oshiradi: haqiqiy hayvonni ko'rish odamlarni atrof-muhitga g'amxo'rlik qilishga darslikdan ko'ra ko'proq ilhomlantiradi.

<mark>Boshqa tomondan</mark>, hayvonlarni asirlikda saqlash jiddiy farovonlik muammolarini keltirib chiqarishini tan olaman.

<mark>Hammasini hisobga olganda</mark>, menimcha, yechim har bir hayvonot bog'ini yopish emas. Aksincha, biz muvozanatni saqlashimiz kerak — hayvonlar farovonligini birinchi o'ringa qo'yadigan, keng va axloqiy qo'riqxonalarga sarmoya kiritib, muhofaza ishini davom ettirishimiz lozim.
t2.uzSampleA1: Ba'zilar hayvonot bog'lari yomon deydi. Ba'zilar yaxshi deydi. Menga hayvonot bog'lari yoqadi. Hayvonot bog'ida biz ko'p hayvonni ko'ramiz. Bolalar hayvonlar haqida o'rganadi. Lekin hayvonlarga joy kerak. Shuning uchun hayvonot bog'lari katta va toza bo'lishi kerak. Menimcha ular qolishi mumkin, lekin hayvonlarga yaxshi bo'lishi kerak.
t2.uzSampleA2: Ba'zilar barcha hayvonlar tabiatda yashashi kerak deydi. Boshqalar hayvonot bog'lari yaxshi deydi. Menimcha ular yaxshi bo'lishi mumkin. Hayvonot bog'ida biz hayvonlarni ko'ramiz va ular haqida o'rganamiz. Ular yo'qolib ketayotgan turlarga ham yordam beradi. Lekin hayvonlarga ko'p joy va yaxshi ovqat kerak. Xulosa qilib, menimcha ular qolishi mumkin, lekin katta, toza va hayvonlar uchun xavfsiz bo'lishi kerak.
t2.uzSampleB1: Bu qizg'in muhokama qilinadigan mavzu. Ba'zilar barcha yovvoyi hayvonlar faqat tabiatda yashashi kerak deydi, lekin men to'liq rozi emasman. Avvalo, yaxshi hayvonot bog'lari muhim rol o'ynaydi, chunki ular yo'qolib ketayotgan turlarni himoya qiladi va ko'payishiga yordam beradi. Shuningdek, bolalar haqiqiy hayvonlarni ko'rganda, tabiatni sevishni o'rganadi. Boshqa tomondan, ba'zi hayvonot bog'lari juda kichik va hayvonlar baxtli emas. Shuning uchun hayvonlar g'amgin yoki kasal bo'lib qolishi mumkin. Xulosa qilib, menimcha ular yopilmasligi kerak, lekin katta va toza bo'lishi, hayvonlarga yaxshi g'amxo'rlik qilishi kerak.
t2.uzSampleB2: Bu juda qiziq savol, va rostini aytsam, men ikkala tomonni ham tushunaman. Bir tomondan, yovvoyi tabiatda erkin sayr qilish uchun tug'ilgan hayvonlarni asirlikda saqlashda bir oz g'amginlik bor. Shunga qaramay, har bir hayvonot bog'ini yopish yechim emas deb o'ylayman. Zamonaviy hayvonot bog'lari juda ko'p yaxshilik qiladi — ular ko'paytirish dasturlari orqali hayvonlarni yo'q bo'lib ketishdan himoya qiladi va hech qanday hujjatli film qila olmaydigan tarzda xabardorlikni oshiradi. Bola haqiqiy filni ko'rganda, ko'pincha uni himoya qilishga jalb bo'lishni istaydi. Bundan tashqari, har bir hayvonni yovvoyi tabiatga qo'yib yuborish real emas; ko'plari omon qolmaydi. Shuning uchun men uchun hayvonot bog'lari ikki tomoni o'tkir qilichga o'xshaydi. Haqiqiy yechim — muvozanatni saqlash: shafqatsiz, eski bog'larni yopib, hayvonlarni chinakam birinchi o'ringa qo'yadigan zamonaviy qo'riqxonalarni qo'llab-quvvatlash. Boshqalar nima deb o'ylaydi?

t11.title: Informal letter · to friend
t11.prompt: Write a letter to your friend, who also visits the sports center. Write about the planned changes and ask if they agree with your opinion.
t11.sample: Hi Sam, Hope you're keeping well! I just heard the sports center is finally doing up the basketball court and adding an indoor games area. Honestly, I think it's a step in the right direction. The extra weekend classes sound great too. Do you reckon these changes are worth it? Let me know your thoughts! Cheers, Daniel
t11.sampleA1: Hi Tom, Our sports center will change. There is a new basketball court. There is a new games room too. There are new fitness classes at the weekend. I like it. Do you like it? Please tell me. Alex
t11.sampleA2: Hi Tom, I have news about our sports center. They will make a new basketball court and a games area. They will also have more fitness classes at the weekend. I think this is good. Do you agree with me? Please write soon. Alex
t11.sampleB1: Hi Tom, I have some news about our sports center. They are going to renovate the basketball court and add a new games area. They will also start more fitness classes at the weekend. I think these changes are a great idea. Do you agree with me? Please tell me what you think. Best wishes, Alex
t11.sampleB2: Hi Aziz, Guess what? Our sports center is finally getting a makeover — they're doing up the basketball court and putting in a brand-new indoor games area! There'll be extra fitness classes at weekends too. Personally, I think it's a great idea, but I'd love to know if you go along with that. Let me know! Cheers, Dilnoza

t12.title: Formal letter · to manager
t12.prompt: Write a letter to the sports center manager. Explain your opinion about the planned changes and suggest some ideas that could improve the sports center in the future.
t12.sample: Dear Sir or Madam, Thank you for your email regarding the proposed improvements to the sports center. In my opinion, the plans are a commendable initiative. Renovating the basketball court is long overdue, and a dedicated indoor games area would cater to members who prefer activities beyond team sports. What I value most about the center is its friendly, inclusive atmosphere, and I believe the additional weekend classes would strengthen this a sense of community. Looking ahead, I would like to suggest a few further ideas. Installing outdoor exercise equipment would appeal to those who enjoy training in the fresh air, while introducing discounted family memberships could encourage more people to join. Thank you for taking my suggestions into consideration. Yours faithfully, Daniel Foster
t12.sampleA1: Dear Sir or Madam, The changes are good. I like the new basketball court. The games area is good too. I have an idea. Please put lights outside. Please make classes for children. Thank you. Yours faithfully, Alex Carter
t12.sampleA2: Dear Sir or Madam, I am writing about the new plans for the sports center. I think they are good. The new basketball court and games area are very useful. I have some ideas too. You can put lights outside for the evening. You can also make classes for children. Thank you. Yours faithfully, Alex Carter
t12.sampleB1: Dear Sir or Madam, I am writing about the planned changes to the sports center. I think they are a great idea. The new basketball court and indoor games area will be very useful, and more weekend classes will help people keep fit. But I have some ideas for the future. Maybe you could put outdoor exercise equipment in the garden, so people can train outside. You could also start classes for children. I think many members would like this. Thank you very much. Yours faithfully, Alex Carter
t12.sampleB2: Dear Sir or Madam, Thank you for your email about the planned improvements to the sports center. I think they are excellent. The renovated basketball court and the new indoor games area will offer members a wide range of activities, and the extra weekend classes are exactly what many of us need to keep fit. Looking ahead, I would like to suggest a couple of ideas. Firstly, installing outdoor exercise equipment would be popular with people who prefer training in the open air. Secondly, offering discounted family memberships might encourage more families to join and help build a sense of community. Thank you for taking my feedback on board. I look forward to hearing about your final decision. Yours faithfully, Bekzod Aliyev
t12.uzSample:
Hurmatli janob yoki xonim,

Sport markazini yaxshilash bo'yicha taklifingiz haqidagi xatingiz uchun tashakkur. Mening fikrimcha, rejalar <mark>maqtovga sazovor tashabbus</mark>. Basketbol maydonchasini ta'mirlash <mark>ancha kechikkan</mark>, yopiq o'yinlar zonasi esa jamoaviy sportdan tashqari mashg'ulotlarni afzal ko'radigan a'zolarning <mark>ehtiyojlarini qondiradi</mark>.

Markazda men eng qadrlaydigan narsa — uning do'stona va hamma uchun ochiq muhiti, va menimcha dam olish kunlaridagi qo'shimcha darslar bu <mark>hamjamiyat tuyg'usini</mark> mustahkamlaydi.

Kelajakka nazar tashlab, bir nechta qo'shimcha g'oya taklif qilmoqchiman. Ochiq havoda mashq qilish jihozlarini o'rnatish toza havoda mashq qilishni yoqtiradiganlarni jalb qiladi, chegirmali oilaviy a'zolikni joriy etish esa ko'proq odamni jalb qilishi mumkin.

Takliflarimni inobatga olganingiz uchun tashakkur.

Hurmat bilan,
Daniel Foster

Yangi basketbol maydonchasi va yopiq o'yinlar zonasi juda foydali bo'ladi, dam olish kunlaridagi ko'proq darslar esa odamlarga sog'lom bo'lib turishga yordam beradi. Lekin kelajak uchun menda g'oyalar bor. Balki bog'ga ochiq havoda mashq qilish jihozlarini qo'yarsiz, shunda odamlar tashqarida mashq qiladi. Bolalar uchun ham darslar boshlashingiz mumkin. Menimcha, ko'p a'zo buni yoqtiradi. Katta rahmat. Hurmat bilan, Alex Carter

Ta'mirlangan basketbol maydonchasi va yangi yopiq o'yinlar zonasi a'zolarga keng turdagi mashg'ulotlarni taklif etadi, dam olish kunlaridagi qo'shimcha darslar esa ko'pchiligimizga sog'lom bo'lib turish uchun aynan kerak. Kelajakka nazar tashlab, bir nechta g'oya taklif qilmoqchiman. Birinchidan, ochiq havoda mashq qilish jihozlarini o'rnatish toza havoda mashq qilishni afzal ko'radiganlarga yoqadi. Ikkinchidan, chegirmali oilaviy a'zolikni taklif qilish ko'proq oilalarni jalb qilib, hamjamiyat tuyg'usini shakllantirishi mumkin. Fikrimni inobatga olganingiz uchun tashakkur. Yakuniy qaroringizni kutib qolaman. Hurmat bilan, Bekzod Aliyev

tasks.p1_context: You are a member of a community sports center. You received an email from the sports center manager.
tasks.p1_scenario:
Dear Member,

We are planning to improve our sports center to make it more enjoyable for everyone. We are thinking of renovating the basketball court and adding a new indoor games area. We are also considering offering more fitness classes at weekends.

Before making a final decision, we would like to hear your opinion. What do you like most about the sports center? Do you think these changes would be useful? Are there any other improvements or activities you would recommend?

We appreciate your feedback and suggestions.

Kind regards,

The Sports Center Manager
